title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - CodeArtifact
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/CodeArtifact. A piece of software that can be executed by a Compute service. Subclass of SoftwareResource per the Gaia-X ontology; declares no properties of its own beyond those inherited (documented on the SoftwareResource model). The source ontology marks this class as abstract, not intended for direct instantiation -- included here per the full-ontology translation scope; concrete Gaia-X code-artifact subtypes (e.g. ContainerImage, PXEImage, VMImage) are modeled as their own entities.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CodeArtifact'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
